system.name: IDEA-Bench
system.one_liner: A benchmark of 100 professional image generation tasks in five categories with 275 cases and 1,650 evaluation questions.

content.argues: IDEA-Bench spans 100 professional design tasks in five categories of input-output type, and its leaderboard shows the best model scoring 22.48 of 100.

lessons.what_to_learn: Summarise a benchmark in one composite: give each category a colour, show one example card per category (title with task count, subtask, input and output thumbnails, dashed prompt), a ranked leaderboard, and a sunburst whose sectors reuse the card colours and carry every subtask name.
lessons.suits: Benchmark or dataset papers with a few task categories and many subtasks that want taxonomy, examples and a headline ranking in one figure.

evidence: IDEA-Bench comprises 5 categories, encompassing a total of 100 professional-level subtasks, 275 cases, and 1,650 hierarchical evaluation questions.
Each category provides subtask examples, quantitative statistics, and showcases a leaderboard of mainstream models.
text-to-image, image-to-image, images-to-image, text-to-images, and image(s)-to-images

summary: IDEA-Bench is a benchmark of 100 professional image generation tasks in five categories, with 275 cases and 1,650 evaluation questions. Figure 1 packs three views of it into one composite. At the left, five colour-bordered cards, one per category (Image(s) to Images, Images to Image, Image to Image, Text to Images, Text to Image), each with a task title and count, a subtask example with input and output thumbnails and a dashed prompt box. Between two of them sits a leaderboard of nine models with medals for the top three, led by GPT-4o + FLUX-1 at 22.48 of 100. At the right, a large sunburst with IDEA-Bench at its centre fans the five categories out into groups and about 100 rotated subtask names, in the card colours.
summary_zh: IDEA-Bench 是含 100 个专业图像生成任务、分五类的基准。图含三部分：左侧五张彩色边框卡片各给出一类任务的标题、缩略图和提示词，其间夹着九个模型的排行榜；右侧是以 IDEA-Bench 为中心的旭日图，颜色与卡片对应。
notes: Primary kind changed from the prior contribution-mosaic to scope-overview (benchmark-dashboard): the pieces summarise one benchmark's coverage (task taxonomy, examples, ranking) rather than separate contributions; contribution-mosaic stays as a second kind. The sunburst leaf labels are about 2.5 pt and were not transcribed beyond examples. Cards and sectors are matched by colour and by task counts (18, 25, 25, 21 and 11 add up to the 100 subtasks of the caption). The digest counts 15 placed bitmaps, fewer than the thumbnails seen, so some thumbnails are probably one strip image.
